build.deployment: hot reload only, install A (C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Alterum), private lobby, 640x360 headed, 15 fps cap; no restart, no host/Contracts change

rules.order: first candidate in table order with usable room wins; 'behind' is first, so the fallbacks never replace it
rules.accept: full ray from the eye: room = firstHit - 0.20 m (or infinite), must be >= the candidate's own floor (+ 0.30 m hysteresis while the rig is refusing), and the sight line from the pose to the body centre and to the head must be clear of foreign colliders
rules.distance: min(candidate ray, room) - a hard maximum, never lengthened; approach immediate, pull-back smoothed at 12/s
rules.aim: body bound centre, pitch fitted to the camera's own vertical fov; head kept below the frame top by a 5 deg margin
rules.projection: never written: fov 70.000, near 0.010, far 500 in every dump

geometry.wall: Palatka_Low/Colliders/Collider (3), size (0.301, 2.250, 4.540), face 0.34 m behind the eye, top 0.594 m above it
geometry.ceiling: Collider (6) 1.06 m above the eye at the wall line, 1.14-1.26 m along a 70 deg ray

probe_room_behind_eye_m.elev_60: clear to 3.0 (passes above the roof line)

stability_60_frames_idle.note: position exact; the aim pitch follows the idle-animated body bounds by <=0.34 deg

masks.after_reload_restore: 0x4DDB8F87 (every generation records this as its pristine mask)

first_person.note: on/off masks are both 0x4DDB8F87, so the pair is byte-identical

no_room_fallback.note: forced-fallback build: the game's eye pose, both bits withdrawn

mirror.third_person: reflection shows body + hat (screen camera has both bits)
mirror.first_person: reflection shows body + hat (screen camera has neither)
mirror.binding_condition: the mirror keeps the body in first person only when its binding captured the owner-hide key, i.e. when it was bound while first person was active (keys=2). A mirror bound in third person has keys=0 and the game's first-person hide passes through; one POV cycle then leaves the body renderers disabled until the next rebind. Pre-existing, unchanged by this work.
